item.title: EKSに最適化されたWindows Server 2025 AMIでのCimFSスナップショッターのサポート
item.description: Amazon EKSに最適化されたWindows Server 2025 AMIは、オプトインコンポジットイメージファイルシステム（ CimFS ）コンテナスナップショッターをサポートするようになりました。この機能により、大きなWindowsコンテナイメージのコールドイメージのプル時間を短縮できます。CimFSはKubernetesバージョン1.35以降で利用でき、デフォルトでオフになっています。

item.title: EKS-optimized AL2023 NVIDIA AMI includes two NVIDIA driver versions
item.description: The EKS-optimized AL2023 NVIDIA AMI now bundles two NVIDIA driver versions in a single AMI. Each node automatically selects the appropriate driver for its GPU at boot, enabling support for the g7 instance type without building a custom AMI.

item.title: Deterministic Argo CD capability endpoint
item.description: Documented the format of the EKS Capability for Argo CD endpoint. The endpoint hostname is deterministic, so you can construct it from your capability name, cluster name, AWS account ID, and AWS Region, or retrieve it from the serverUrl field of describe-capability.

item.title: AWS PrivateLink for the cluster OIDC endpoint
item.description: Amazon EKS now supports AWS PrivateLink for the cluster OIDC discovery/JWKS endpoint (com.amazonaws.region-code.oidc-eks), letting you reach the endpoint used by IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) privately from your VPC without internet egress.

item.title: EFA support for static capacity in EKS Auto Mode
item.description: Added support for configuring EFA network interfaces on EKS Auto Mode NodeClass resources. You can now statically define network interfaces at instance launch for high-performance distributed training and inference workloads.

item.title: Service-linked role update
item.description: Added AmazonEKSPodIdentityPolicy to the list of access policies in AmazonEKSServiceRolePolicy that the service-linked role can associate and dissociate from cluster access entries. With this addition, Amazon EKS can manage pod identity credentials for workloads running on EKS clusters.

item.title: Control plane egress routing
item.description: Added support for customer-routed control plane egress (controlPlaneEgressMode=CUSTOMER_ROUTED), letting you manage the network path from the cluster control plane to resources in your VPC.

item.title: New AWS managed policy
item.description: Introduced AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicyV2 and AmazonEBSCSIDriverEKSClusterScopedPolicy as more restrictive alternatives to AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy. AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicyV2 scopes the EBS CSI driver to volumes and snapshots tagged with ebs.csi.aws.com/cluster set to true. AmazonEBSCSIDriverEKSClusterScopedPolicy scopes the driver to volumes and snapshots belonging to a specific EKS cluster using the ebs.csi.aws.com/cluster-name tag.
